{"ops": [{"insert": "父子联手，挑战老旧巨头，做到1100万美元ARR"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": {"image": "https://storage.googleapis.com/indie-hackers.appspot.com/post-images/61O715V0AXD6kZ1j8hsc/vOqaQ3DJwYRP8MNEjUOSMger71w1/shoanak-mallapurkar-founder-of-recruit-crm.png"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "> 作者: Sean Mallapurkar", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "> 标签: 广告、自举创业、内容营销、SaaS、SEO", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你见过几对父子创业成功的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Sean和他爸是一组。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "而且很成功。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Sean在recruitment businesses长大——他爸在industry几十年（Randstad、ADP），所以他front-row seat看agencies怎么operated。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Indiana University Kelley School of Business提前毕业，move到Bay Area在venture-backed startup工作。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那经历valuable，但也让他realize想build something more durable and capital-efficient。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2017年，和他爸start Recruit CRM。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在Recruit CRM是SaaS平台（ATS + CRM）for recruitment和executive search firms。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Fully bootstrapped，2021年初hit first million，现在近1100万美元ARR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "年增长约40%，维持约40% free cash flow margins。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "服务约2000家recruitment firms，横跨100+国家。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大部分客户在美国和西欧。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Focus简单：帮recruitment agencies make more placements with less effort。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从candidate tracking、client management到workflow automation、reporting、integrations。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他很早understood industry。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "始终注意到software对他爸day-to-day operations有多critical——但大部分felt outdated and clunky。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "后来在Bay Area venture-backed startup工作，看到"modern SaaS"能长什么样——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Great UX、fast iteration cycles、customer-driven development。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "对比鲜明。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Recruitment software没evolve at same pace。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Recruit CRM的idea来自这里。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "看到机会build modern、easy-to-use ATS + CRM specifically for recruitment和executive search firms——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "让recruiters more productive而不是slow them down。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "另一个big motivator是想怎么build company itself。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Deliberately决定bootstrap。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不想optimize for vanity metrics或burn——从第一天就想要profitable、durable business。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以不只是"there's a gap in the market"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "也是"we understand this customer deeply、product category is behind、we can build better、more sustainable company while fixing it"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Early days scrappy and customer-driven。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "花了不到7万美元reach first dollar of revenue in 2018。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "没从grand product vision或big team开始——从和tons of recruitment agencies聊开始。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因为他爸的背景，第一天就directly access real users。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "花significant time理解recruiters怎么work——怎么track candidates、manage clients、existing tools like Bullhorn哪里fall short。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Build initial product解决几个core workflows effectively："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Managing candidates和clients in one place", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Tracking recruitment pipeline (jobs、submissions、placements)", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "让它fast and intuitive to use day-to-day", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Deliberately kept scope tight。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "No bloat，no "enterprise checklist" features——just something recruiter能快速pick up、enjoy using。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Execution side，小队mostly engineers in India，fast iterate。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ship something，get handful of customers的feedback，almost immediately refine。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "没long roadmap——更像tight feedback loop。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "One thing got right early：charging from the beginning。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "即使product basic，也没position成free tool。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Force build something people genuinely find valuable，not just "nice to have"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "技术栈很pragmatic——nothing overly fancy，just things let move fast and scale reliably。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Backend主要用PHP，Laravel-based architecture。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Frontend用mix of JavaScript frameworks（evolved over time as product grew）。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Infrastructure host在Amazon Web Services，most core data在Ireland region。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "也在multiple regions跑read replicas（像US和India）保持产品fast for global customer base。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Performance matters a lot因为recruiters整天live inside the product——不是occasionally use的东西。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""Stack" big part beyond languages和frameworks是think about building的方式："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Optimize for speed of iteration over perfection", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Avoid over-engineering early", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Invest in stability and performance as scale", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "也建了robust API layer，allow integrations with各种third-party tools——email、job boards、sourcing tools等，因为recruitment workflows ecosystem-heavy。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "At their stage，stack less about specific technologies，more about system let ~150+ people ship consistently without breaking things。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "商业模式straightforward SaaS。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Charge recruitment agencies per-user、per-month subscription fee access Recruit CRM。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Pricing scales with users数量和feature tier，所以grow with customers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Most customers是小到mid-sized recruitment和executive search firms，典型1-200 recruiters。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Keep things clean——no services-heavy model，no complicated contracts。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "High-margin、recurring revenue focused on long-term retention。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "挑战不少："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Build global company from day one", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Customers主要在美国和西欧，团队主要在India。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "早期time zones、communication、deeply understanding customer创造challenges。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建了strong feedback loops——sales calls、support conversations、customer interviews——stay close to users despite geographic gap。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Over time became strength，但initially not easy。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Competing with incumbents", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "和Bullhorn等established players竞争，资源多很多、brand recognition强。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Can't outspend them，so had to out-focus them——better UX、faster iteration、tighter alignment with what customers wanted。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Staying disciplined while growing fast", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Bootstrapping hindsight great，但实践中tough。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Every hire、every dollar spent、every experiment matters。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Growth slowed或things didn't work as expected during certain phases时，lack external capital cushion that。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Learned how to build real business——profitable、efficient、resilient——rather than just chasing growth。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "If do differently："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Go slightly more upmarket earlier：早期focus heavily on smaller agencies helped grow fast，但move upmarket earlier（higher ACVs、more structured sales）会accelerate revenue。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Invest in leadership sooner：他爸和他自己do too much for a while。Earlier bring in strong operators——尤其sales和marketing——会help scale faster。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Be more aggressive with pricing earlier：和很多bootstrapped founders一样，initially underpriced。Over time corrected，但earlier confidence in pricing会improve revenue和positioning。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Five unfair advantages："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Deep customer proximity", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "：他爸recruitment background gave very real understanding of user from start。Not guess what to build，solved problems firsthand seen。Even today staying close to customers（calls、feedback loops、support conversations）probably biggest advantage。", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Bootstrapping discipline", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "：Not raising venture capital forced build real business early——profitable、efficient、focused on retention。Couldn't hide behind burn or vanity metrics。Discipline compounds over time，showing up in strong margins和more resilient company。", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Content and SEO as acquisition engine", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "：Early investing in content unlocked significant growth。Not glamorous，takes time，但一旦work就compounds。Much of content wrote years ago still brings in high-intent customers today。", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Simplicity in product and positioning", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "：Consistently keep product intuitive and focused。Bullhorn等tools feel complex的空间里，ease of use是real differentiator。Help adoption、conversion、word-of-mouth。", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Global cost structure", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "：India建team、美国和欧洲sell gave strong early cost advantage。Allow invest in product和grow without external capital。", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Growth primarily from strong inbound、solid product、compounding growth。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Early days，content和SEO驱动几乎所有growth。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Deeply explored recruitment niche，写guides、playbooks、templates recruiters actually search for。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Eventually built strong inbound engine，allow people discover them when already looking for ATS/CRM。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "同时，heavy focus on making product easy adopt。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Recruiters lack time for complex implementations，所以fast onboarding和clean UX key。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Help conversion，more importantly word-of-mouth，因为agencies frequently communicate。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "长大后加了更多channels："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Performance marketing（主要Google）capture high-intent demand", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Sales team handle larger deals、move upmarket", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Customer success drive retention和expansion", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Important：没try do everything at once。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "First established inbound，then added sales，then expanded into more structured go-to-market。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在inbound和referrals still drive much growth，supported by more mature GTM engine。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这approach advantage of compounding——content wrote years ago still brings in customers，satisfied users keep referring others。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Bootstrapped nature also forced discipline。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Couldn't simply spend way to growth，so every channel needed to be efficient and repeatable。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "给创始人的建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Start with painful、well-understood problem", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "：Don't start with idea——start with user和problem you understand deeply。Recruitment不是random，seen workflows up close for years，reduce much guesswork。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Talk to users constantly", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "：Early on biggest advantage是learning speed。Get on calls、watch how people use product、iterate fast。Most founders don't talk to users enough——build in isolation。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Charge early", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "：即使small amount，charge from beginning。Force build something people value，not just say "cool"。Free users give feedback，paying users give truth。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Keep product simple", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "：尤其beginning，do few things well。Very tempting add features，但focus wins。Most successful products just small set of workflows executed well。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Pick one acquisition channel and go deep", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "：他们focus on content和SEO。Others might focus on outbound或communities。但don't try do everything at once——get one channel working，then layer on more。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Be patient with compounding", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "：Content、word-of-mouth、product quality take time，but compound massively。Many people quit right before things start working。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stay capital-efficient (at least early on)", "attributes": {"bold": true, "list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "：Don't need raise money get started。事实上constraints can be good thing——force clarity and discipline。Can always raise later，但hard undo culture of burning money。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "下一步："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Move upmarket and increase ACVs：Built strong base with small和mid-sized agencies，现在aim serve larger、more sophisticated firms。Better enterprise features、more structured sales、stronger presence in markets like US。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Build category-defining product：Don't just want be another ATS/CRM——want be default system recruitment firms use run entire business。Go deeper into workflows、automation、reporting、integrations，while still keeping product simple and intuitive。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Strengthen global GTM engine：Investing more in sales、marketing、customer success complement inbound engine。Historically very product-和content-led——now building more complete go-to-market motion。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Scale leadership and organization：Growing时building strong leadership team priority。Spend lot of time bringing in experienced operators能take over key functions、eventually scale company beyond founders。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stay profitable while growing fast：Continue growing strong pace (~30-40%+) while maintaining healthy margins。Bootstrapped shaped how think about building——profitability and durability matter。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "长期simple ambition：在recruitment space建large、enduring SaaS company——compound for decades，not just few years。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文链接:", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " https://www.indiehackers.com/post/61O715V0AXD6kZ1j8hsc"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "本内容基于 Indie Hackers 文章二次创作，采用 咪蒙式叙事风格重写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}, {"insert": "

content_en:
Father-Son Team, Challenging Old Giants, $11M ARR


> Author: Sean Mallapurkar

> Tags: Advertising, Bootstrapped, Content Marketing, SaaS, SEO


How many father-son entrepreneurial success stories have you seen?

Sean and his dad are one pair.

And they're very successful.

---

Sean grew up in recruitment businesses—his dad was in the industry for decades (Randstad, ADP), so he had a front-row seat watching how agencies operated.

Graduated early from Indiana University Kelley School of Business, moved to Bay Area to work at a venture-backed startup.

That experience was valuable, but also made him realize he wanted to build something more durable and capital-efficient.

---

In 2017, he started Recruit CRM with his dad.

Now Recruit CRM is a SaaS platform (ATS + CRM) for recruitment and executive search firms.

Fully bootstrapped, now at $11M ARR.

---

Key insight: Leverage family experience, build on proven domain expertise.
content_jp:
親子联手%、旧巨匠に挑戦%、1100万美元ARR


> 著者：Sean Mallapurkar

> タグ：広告、ブートストラップ、コンテンツマーケティング、SaaS、SEO


親子で起業に成功した話はいくつか見た？

Seanとお父さんはその一组。

それに大成功している。

---

Seanはrecruitmentビジネスで育った—お父さんは業界で何十年%（Randstad、ADP）%、 поэтому 彼はagencyがどうoperateするか front-row seat で見てた。

Indiana University Kelley School of Business，提前卒業%、Bay Areaに移ってventure-backed startupで勤務。

その経験は贵重だった%、でもより耐久性と资本效率の高いものを構築したいと觉悟させた。

---

2017年%、お父さんとRecruit CRMを開始。

今、Recruit CRMはSaaSプラットフォーム（ATS + CRM）for recruitmentとexecutive search firms。

フルブートストラップ%、今1100万美元ARR。

---

重要な洞察：家族の経験を活用しろ%、実証済みのドメインの専門知識の上に構築せよ。
content_ar:
فريق الأب والابن، تحدي العمالقة القدامى، 11 مليون دولار من الإيرادات السنوية المتكررة


> المؤلف: شون مالابوركار

> الكلمات المفتاحية: الإعلانات، البدء بدون استثمار، تسويق المحتوى، البرمجيات كخدمة، محركات البحث


كم من قصص نجاح ريادة الأعمال بين الأب والابن رأيت؟

شون وأبيه زوج واحد.

그리고 매우 성공적이다.

---

ترعرع شون في أعمال التوظيف—والده كان في الصناعة لعقود (Randstad، ADP)، لذلك كان في الصف الأول يشاهد كيف تعمل الوكالات.

تخرج مبكراً من كلية كيلي لإدارة الأعمال في جامعة إنديانا، وانتقل إلى منطقة خليج للعمل في شركة ناشئة مدعومة رأس المال.

كانت تلك القيمة الثمينة، لكنه أدرك أيضاً أنه يريد بناء شيء أكثر استدامة وكفاءة في رأس المال.

---

في 2017، بدأ Recruit CRM مع والده.

الآن Recruit CRM هو منصة برمجيات كخدمة (ATS + CRM) لشركات التوظيف والبحث التنفيذي.

بدون استثمار، الآن عند 11 مليون دولار من الإيرادات السنوية المتكررة.

---

رؤية رئيسية: استغل الخبرة العائلية، ابنِ على خبرة مجال مثبتة.
